plain: Shadows inside a dark-themed section (data-theme on an element, not <html>) now render dark; nothing to change.

steps.plain: This variable is now also declared in the dark block, so it renders dark inside a dark-themed section; if you override it under [data-theme="dark"], your override still wins.
